description: Operational life of the Met Buoy is anticipated to be 6 years.
context_quote: The operational life of the Met Buoy is anticipated to be 6 years.

The Met Buoy will be deployed in federal waters of the Atlantic Ocean within OCS Block 6965, Aliquot M of the Official Protraction Diagram Providence NK19-07 (see Addendum A of North Lease, and Figure 1-1).
The location of the Met Buoy is at or about 41° 05’ 16” N and 71° 13’ 22” W.

description: Water depth at Met Buoy Installation Area.
context_quote: Water depth at the Met Buoy Installation Area is approximately 115 ft (35.1 m).

description: Vessel speed restriction within a Dynamic Management Area (DMA).
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure that all vessel operators comply with 10 knot (<18.5 km/hr) speed restrictions in any Dynamic Management Area (DMA)

description: Vessel speed restriction for vessels 65 feet or greater.
context_quote: In addition, the Lessee must ensure that vessels 65 feet in length or greater, operating from November 1 through July 31, operate at speeds of 10 knots (<18.5 km/hr) or less.

description: Maintain 500 m separation distance from North Atlantic right whales.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 500 m (1,640 ft) or greater from any sighted North Atlantic right whale(s).

description: Maintain 100 m separation distance from non-delphinoid cetaceans (excluding North Atlantic right whales).
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 100 m (328 ft) or greater from any sighted non-delphinoid cetacean(s) other than a North Atlantic right whale.

description: Maintain 50 m separation distance from delphinoid cetaceans.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure that all vessels maintain a separation distance of 50 m (164 ft) or greater from any sighted delphinoid cetacean(s).

description: Maintain 50 m separation distance from sea turtles.
context_quote: The Lessee must ensure all vessels maintain a separation distance of 50 m (164 ft) or greater from any sighted sea turtle(s).
